summary: The change adds a conflict-safe three-scope account-creation reservation in auth_store and applies it before password hashing and registration challenge writes in register, continue, and register/start. The added concurrent tests exercise the admission limit, rejection before PBKDF2 work, and bounded user and challenge KV growth.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts:1598-1663 implements reserveAccountCreation with atomic checks and expiring source, global, and service counters.
src/passport.ts:772-780, src/passport.ts:869-874, and src/passport.ts:946-949 reserve admission before hashPassword, verifyPassword, per-email rate-limit writes, or saveChallenge.
src/handler_test.ts:2796-2946 adds concurrent tests for the allowed budget, rejection before PBKDF2 work, and bounded user and challenge row growth.
